keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The Act of Union 1840, 'proclaimed by the Crown on 10 February 1841', merged the colonies of Upper Canada and Lower Canada; the page gives no area or boundary. Sanity check on the parts: Upper Canada 258,999 km2 (1836) and Lower Canada 534,185 km2 (1839) from their infoboxes sum to 793,184 km2; the gazetteer shape is 870,482 km2 (ratio 1.10).

notes: Not a Cliopatria row. One page opened for the dossier (Province of Canada, queried twice); the Upper Canada and Lower Canada pages (opened for their own dossiers) give the areas used in the sanity check. Not on the page: any area, the Ottawa River, the boundary treaties of 1842 and 1846 (the Oregon treaty is named once, as the reason a governor general became dispensable), Rupert's Land beyond the 1850s interest in annexation, the Fenian raids. Disagreements: Kingston 1841-1843 (text) vs 1841-1844 (infobox); Ottawa chosen 1858, implemented 1859, occupied 1865 (infobox 1865-1867). The page lists Toronto and Quebec City alternating: the capital entries end each stay one year early so that the validator's non-overlap holds. The Canada dossier's 1867 found event uses british-colonial-empire as counterpart for these provinces.
